refresh.title: Refresh data?
refresh.message: You have unsaved changes. Refreshing will reload data from the database — your changes will be lost unless you save first.

import.title: Import RDF data
import.description: Select a Turtle (.ttl), N-Triples (.nt), or RDF/XML (.rdf) file to load into the database. Imported triples are appended; existing data is not replaced.
import.graphUriHelper: Leave empty to import into the default graph.

labels.inferredHelp: Inferred by the database from other statements. It cannot be edited here and is not saved with the entity.
labels.inferredRelationshipHelp: Stated on “{{entity}}”, not here. Removing it deletes that statement, so the link disappears from both entities.

search.searchHelp: Search across names and titles. End a word with * to also match longer words (e.g. countr*).
search.enterSearchQuery: Enter a search query to find entities
search.enterSearchQueryManifestations: Enter a search query to find manifestations
search.searchFailed: The search could not be completed. Try other search words, or check the connection to the database.

connection.title: Configure Database Connection
connection.description: Enter your SPARQL endpoint details. This information will be stored locally in your browser.
connection.endpointsNote: EntEdit requires GraphDB — full-text search uses its Lucene connectors.
connection.graphdbServerHint: Shared server, GraphDB behind the same address as the app
connection.graphdbPortHint: GraphDB reached directly on its own port

test.title: Test Database Connection
test.description: We'll test the connection to ensure your endpoint is accessible.

languageStep.title: Select Default Language
languageStep.description: Choose your preferred language for labels and interface text. You can change this later.
languageStep.successDescription: Your configuration will be saved locally and the application will connect to your database.

settingsStep.title: Other Settings
settingsStep.description: Choose how the editor treats RDF identifiers and labels. You can change this later in Settings.

testResult.successDetails: Connected to the SPARQL endpoint. The database contains data.
testResult.empty: Connection successful, but the database appears to be empty
testResult.emptyDetails: The endpoint is reachable but no triples were found.
testResult.unauthorizedDetails: The username or password is incorrect. Please check your credentials and try again.
testResult.forbiddenDetails: Your account doesn't have permission to access this endpoint. Contact your database administrator.
testResult.notFoundDetails: The SPARQL endpoint URL is incorrect or the database is not running. Please verify the URL.
testResult.networkDetails:
Cannot reach the database server. This could be:
• The database server is not running
• The URL is incorrect
• A CORS (cross-origin) policy is blocking the request
• A firewall or network restriction
• An SSL/TLS certificate problem if using HTTPS

Try opening the URL directly in your browser to test connectivity.
testResult.corsDetails:
The database server needs to allow requests from this application. For GraphDB, add these CORS headers:
• Access-Control-Allow-Origin: *
• Access-Control-Allow-Methods: GET, POST, OPTIONS
• Access-Control-Allow-Headers: Content-Type, Authorization
